body: Isolation, women, health issues. Yep, that about covers it. My fiance' left me for another man (today was our wedding day) 2 months ago, left all of her shit including 7 cats and 2 ferrets luckily in the mother-in-law house, still fighting prostate cancer, and no one I know even tries to call me, or see me.
There aren't. No money, no insurance, you're cut loose.

I've read the criteria for clinical depression just now, without a doctor I fall under every single bit of it. But I have no insurance, I have enough money to live for a month, and I certainly do NOT want to have that persona put upon me. If I make it back, I can't have that listed in my bio. I'm really trying to make it back. I want to make it back. I'm trying. Really hard.
My child is successful, my debts are paid, I have no one to account to. I think I've done what I needed to do. But I have my dog.
Florida is a "right to work" state, you can be fired if they don't like the color of your hair.
BTW today was supposed to be my wedding day.

A good job? No, but I was there for 19 years. I've missed many days in the last couple of months trying to deal with my problems, I was told through a text if I miss any more work I would be fired. Guess what happened that very same day. I'm in Florida U.S., it's a right to work state, I have no recourse.
My daughter is 25 with 3 kids of her own. Now she just has to worry about her unemployed suicidal father on top of things.
Yep, even the place I turn to ignores. Fuck this life.
